issues.detail: .standards/CONTEXT.md lists under 'Conventions and Constraints' the bullet 'Existing functions and classes carry short one-line docstrings.' The protocol says a user style never overrides project instructions or established constraints, so a careful Documenter could treat this as a project convention conflicting with tony's multi-section NumPy format and stop to ask under Instruction Layering instead of writing the docstring, which would fail the Parameters/Examples contains-checks. The case presents no such conflict. Most runs will treat it as a description of existing state, so this is unlikely to change the result.
